extracted.name: Moscow Mule Cocktail
extracted.description: Learn how to make a Moscow mule! This refreshing cocktail is easy to make with just 3 ingredients. I love it in the summertime or at the holidays—the ginger beer gives it a delicious warming flavor.
instruction_lines: Fill a copper mug* or similar glass with ice. Add the vodka and lime juice and top with the ginger beer. Taste and adjust as desired.
Garnish with a lime wheel and serve.
categories: how to make a moscow mule
